name: Larotrectinib (NTRK fusion-positive thyroid cancer)
cyclesNote: continuous twice-daily dosing until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; not a fixed cycle count

institution.provenance: ONCOTREE draft protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Tissue-agnostic TRK inhibitor gated to a confirmed NTRK1/2/3 gene fusion on validated NGS. Applies to radioiodine-refractory differentiated and to anaplastic thyroid carcinoma harboring an NTRK fusion.

supportiveCare: confirm the NTRK fusion on validated NGS before starting.
monitor for dizziness, fatigue, hepatotoxicity (ALT/AST), and neurologic effects; caution driving early.
continue TSH suppression in differentiated disease; watch for acquired on-target resistance (e.g. solvent-front) at progression.
entrectinib is an accepted alternative TRK inhibitor for the same indication.

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 to 4 hepatotoxicity or other serious toxicity
doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt and resume at a reduced dose per labeling once recovered; obtain clinical review. Physician decides.

drugs.name: Larotrectinib
drugs.notes: Larotrectinib 100 mg PO twice daily, continuous until progression or unacceptable toxicity, is the standard adult dose for NTRK fusion-positive solid tumors including thyroid cancer (per standard guidelines, general reference). Own wording - not a verbatim source copy. Entrectinib 600 mg PO once daily is an alternative TRK inhibitor.
